from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyName(BaseModel):
    """Company name, derived from task context (safe to be Literal)."""
    company: str = Field(description="The company name mentioned in the task, e.g. '汤臣倍健'")

class FinancialPeriod(BaseModel):
    """One reported financial period with the investment activity cash flow amount."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name the filing belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2019年Q1', '2021年Q1'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The as-written label for the metric in Chinese, e.g. '投资活动产生的现金流量净额'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    year_over_year_comparison: str | None = Field(description="Any year-over-year change percentage mentioned in this document, e.g. '上升 224.03%', '下降 147.48%'. None if not mentioned in this document")
    comparison_period: str | None = Field(description="The comparison period mentioned (e.g. '上年同期'), if any comparison data exists in this document")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_name: list[CompanyName]
    financial_periods: list[FinancialPeriod]
